core_idea: Zwei Assoc. South Section 6 Sinclair is a Tank / Status Specialist — **Aggro** frontliner — raise Aggro on key skill slots to pull enemy focus while the kit tanks or sets up. Survivability comes from **Shield** and **Protection**.
playstyle_guide:
- Front-load **+10 Aggro** on the slot you want enemies to target.
- Pair high-Aggro turns with Guard or Assist Defense so passives trigger under pressure.
- Apply Fragile or typed Fragility on the setup turn; coordinate team burst on the next turn.

**S1 — Baton** (BP 4, CP +6, x1): rolls — low 4, high 10 (Extremely Low).

**S2 — Suppress** (BP 6, CP +2, x2): rolls — low 6, high 10 (Extremely Low).
- draws enemy aggro — intended to absorb hits

**S3 — Strong Strike** (BP 7, CP +13, x1): rolls — low 7, high 20 (High).
- draws enemy aggro — intended to absorb hits

Combat passive — **Your Shield**: At the start of the combat phase, give 2 Defense Power Up and 1 Protection to allies adjacent to this unit on the Dashboard.

Combat passive — **Stubbornness**: 1 ally with the least HP takes -10% damage.
team_suggestions: **Aggro** frontliner — draws enemy focus so teammates can apply statuses and burst safely.
- Pair with identities whose support passives inflict statuses this kit stacks or scales off.
